proposed.explanation: While separation is good, the specific arrangement isn't optimal. Administrative oversight doesn't require vertical positioning above clinical areas. Single-floor concentration eliminates the benefits of vertical separation. Vertical stacking can work, but ICU and surgery (specialized, equipment-intensive, restricted access) should serve multiple inpatient floors efficiently. Placing them at the top isolates them from patients they serve. Better organization: ambulatory at ground (public), inpatient units middle (semi-public), specialized services (ICU, OR) mid-level serving inpatient floors, administrative top or separate location.
